page.layout: One printed page with a running head at the top (title and page number 149 at right). One text column in the centre; marginal notes in the right margin (Iren.l.1.c.9., Socr.l.2.c.28., and faint show-through). Catchword/footer line "L 3 docuit" at the foot, below the text block, read as a signature line with catchword.

main_text.p: remotus minùs impediat circumscriptionem, quam pars alterius proximi; Quid delirare est si hoc sit sapere? Quis non rideat horum sapientem stultitiam, quod de Valentinianis Irenæus? Iren.l.1.c.9.

Sed lubens audio illud Chrysostomi; Ex philosophiâ res diuinas intelligere, est candens ferrum non forcipe, sed digitis contrectare, quin & Augustini; Da Deum aliquid posse quod tu non possis intelligere; Aetium haereticum in errorem illum Arrij putidissimum seduxisse fertur Aristoteles: Quin & omnes haereses a philosophiâ subornari Socr.l.2.c.28.

page.notes: The text column is in the left block; the signature "L 3" and catchword "docuit" are printed in the footer line. Faint show-through of the facing page appears in the margins and was not transcribed. Marginal note "Socr.l.2.c.28." is placed at the line where it stands.
